description: This file contains utility functions for audio processing in Pipecat, including mixing, format conversion, volume calculation, and silence detection, as well as resampler factory functions.

classes.name: BaseAudioResampler
classes.description: Base class for audio resampling implementations.

classes.name: SOXRAudioResampler
classes.description: Resampler implementation using SoX for batch processing.

classes.name: SOXRStreamAudioResampler
classes.description: Resampler implementation for real-time stream processing.

methods.name: create_default_resampler
methods.description: Creates a deprecated default resampler instance, warns about deprecation.

methods.name: create_file_resampler
methods.description: Creates a resampler for batch file processing.

methods.name: create_stream_resampler
methods.description: Creates a resampler for real-time streaming.

methods.name: mix_audio
methods.description: Mixes two PCM audio streams by adding samples with clipping.

methods.name: interleave_stereo_audio
methods.description: Interleaves two mono audio streams into a stereo stream.

methods.name: normalize_value
methods.description: Normalizes a value to [0, 1] range and clamps it.

methods.name: calculate_audio_volume
methods.description: Calculates loudness of audio using EBU R128 standard and normalizes.

methods.name: exp_smoothing
methods.description: Applies exponential smoothing to a value.

methods.name: ulaw_to_pcm
methods.description: Converts μ-law encoded audio to PCM and resamples.

methods.name: pcm_to_ulaw
methods.description: Converts PCM to μ-law encoding and resamples.

methods.name: alaw_to_pcm
methods.description: Converts A-law encoded audio to PCM and resamples.

methods.name: pcm_to_alaw
methods.description: Converts PCM to A-law encoding and resamples.

methods.name: is_silence
methods.description: Detects silence in PCM audio based on amplitude threshold.
